sampling_design.broad: randomized Latin hypercube, transformed by each parameter's sampling rule
sampling_design.nominal: half exact nominal; half independently uniform within +/-20%, clipped to allowed ranges
sampling_design.stress: cycle declared endpoint combinations; zero-mean assignment overrides event mean
sampling_design.zero_led_assignment: exact overall fraction; largest-remainder allocation across components; randomly assigned within each component
sampling_design.first_onset: uniform in [0, on_time_s + off_time_s), including fractional sample phase

iq_augmentation.translation_distribution: uniform disk; radius 2 * fixed device maximum noiseless parity contrast
iq_augmentation.independence: independent of physics, noise, zero-LED status and sampling component
iq_augmentation.applied_to: complete noisy complex waveform before float32 export and before baseline inference

baseline.access: same observable waveform and acquisition metadata as model; no per-record nuisance truth
baseline.warning: HMM-SF uses tau as geometric regime lifetime; mu and sigma belong to the separate EMG intensity estimator. Fixed burst probability per sample is rate dependent and needs review.

simulation.additional_charge_resets: independent Poisson process, absolute uniform charge redraws
simulation.snr: maximum noiseless parity contrast divided by per-quadrature single-sample white-noise standard deviation
simulation.readout: instantaneous sampled parity; additive independent white Gaussian I/Q noise
simulation.led_delays: nonnegative-conditioned EMG plus uniform excitation within ON window
simulation.pre_record_pulse_history: none; first onset is the first physical pulse
simulation.observed_truth_window: from first to last sample, as implemented by the parity simulator

scorer.matching: direct minimum total cost one-to-one assignment; no cost-saving match at cutoff
scorer.aggregation: sum over broad/nominal/stress x zero/nonzero strata of fixed component weights x .1/.9 times pooled cost / pooled truth count; lower is better
scorer.empty_truth: empty-record false positives contribute to stratum cost; zero-truth or absent stratum invalidates primary score, exposure diagnostic remains defined

scale.scale_up_condition: measured learning curves, validation uncertainty, throughput and available allocation justify expansion

reserved_combinations.allocation: 3200 independent in-domain reserve plus 800 challenge; no reserve model selection
reserved_combinations.training_validation_exclusion: exclude union A and B; preserve declared component and zero proportions
